create_joint_distribution: create a Joint distribution over a tree of statistically independent distributions with matching batch shapes
sample_from_joint: sample from a Joint distribution and get tree-structured samples matching the underlying distribution structure
compute_log_prob_joint: compute the total log probability of a Joint distribution by summing log probs across all leaf distributions
calculate_kl_divergence_joint: calculate the KL divergence between two Joint distributions with identical tree structures
compute_joint_entropy: compute the entropy of a Joint distribution by summing entropies of all leaf distributions
